title: 'All Thumbs' (2/3)
summaryZh: 說明形容笨手笨腳的英文說法，並用籌備驚喜派對的對話示範用法。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — Words and Their Stories

sentences.text: So people might call me a klutz.
sentences.zh: 所以別人可能會說我是個冒失鬼。

sentences.text: They might also call me butterfingers.
sentences.zh: 他們也可能叫我「奶油手」。

sentences.text: Imagine your fingers are coated in butter.
sentences.zh: 想像一下你的手指上沾滿了奶油。

sentences.text: And it would be hard to pick things up.
sentences.zh: 要拿東西也會變得很困難。

sentences.text: Now let's hear the expression, to be all thumbs, in a conversation between two friends.
sentences.zh: 現在我們來聽聽 to be all thumbs 這個說法，出現在兩個朋友的對話裡。

sentences.text: Hey, I'm planning a surprise party for Nicholas.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我正在幫 Nicholas 籌辦一個驚喜派對。

sentences.text: I'm bringing the food and ice.
And Cassidy is bringing the drinks.
About 50 bottles of wine and lemonade.
sentences.zh: 大概五十瓶葡萄酒和檸檬汁。

sentences.text: Why don't you ask Cassidy to bring the cake?
sentences.zh: 你何不請 Cassidy 帶蛋糕呢？
